name: Seiji Utsuwa
description: A sculptural, gallery-like theme for small online shops of handmade Japanese tableware: celadon bowls, plates, cups and vases from a few small kilns, shown like a museum room. Every object stands on a porcelain plinth with a soft shadow, pictures sit in arches and rounded glaze-pool shapes, catalogue numbers and hairline labels sit under each piece, and there is generous air around everything. Celadon mist, pale celadon, deep kiln teal, unglazed clay and iron-black ink, Brygada 1918 with a celadon italic for titles and Hanken Grotesk for text, slow fade-and-rise reveals and a subtle parallax that stop under reduced motion. Includes a kilns page with a map and maker profiles, a care guide with a material chart and repair notes, a newsletter and a viewing-room contact page, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
